verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents first-party export of contacts and lists at any time. Its API also lets you pull campaign results and search contacts, which covers part of a full data exit. The evidence never names open file formats and never claims export of all data, such as campaign designs, templates, or reports, as a complete package. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), export of all data types (campaigns, templates, reports) not just contacts/lists, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your contacts and lists at any time.
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
